operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of cost centers for the account. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page number. On this endpoint the data level has no visible effect, so `/cost_center/list` and `/cost_center/list/1` return the same result. Pagination is controlled by the `page` and `per_page` query parameters.

| Parameter | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `page` | Page number (default `1`). |
| `per_page` | Items per page (default `20`). |
| `filter[<field>]` | Filter by a field's value, e.g. `filter[code]=1` or `filter[is_primary]=1`. Filterable fields: `name`, `code`, `is_primary`, `cost_center_id`, `cost_center_ids`. |
| `version` | Set to `2` to run each row through the listing formatter. For cost centers the formatted rows have the same fields as the default output. |

The response is a standard paginated envelope; each item in `data` is a flat cost-center record.

Each record's `is_primary` flag is:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Primary (root) cost center |
| 0 | Secondary (child) cost center |

`cost_center_id` is the id of the parent cost center (`0` for a primary/root cost center), and `cost_center_ids` is the comma-separated ancestor path.

parameters.name: filter[<field>]
parameters.description: Filter results by a field's value, e.g. `filter[code]=1`. Filterable fields: `name`, `code`, `is_primary`, `cost_center_id`, `cost_center_ids`.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Set to `2` to run each row through the listing formatter. Same fields as the default output for this entity.

200.description: A paginated list of cost centers.

data.description: The cost centers on this page. Each item is a flat cost-center record.

code.description: Cost center code. Unique across the account.

is_primary.description:
Whether this is a primary (root) cost center.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 1 | Primary (root) |
| 0 | Secondary (child) |

cost_center_id.description: Id of the parent cost center. `0` for a primary/root cost center.

cost_center_ids.description: Comma-separated ancestor path of parent cost-center ids.

branch_id.description: Id of the branch the cost center belongs to.

400.description: The list could not be produced.

error.description: Reason the list could not be produced.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.
